meta.source: Ported from Reputation-Matrix2/liberated-toads-system.js into Waluipedia as a faction-linked system.
meta.note: Operational snapshot frozen at Highsun 21, 1040 BF (Day 21) — the Order 120 emergency. The wider archive clock has advanced to Aethel 1040 BF, so this record is deliberately behind the present day; the Toad crisis has not been narrated forward yet.

structure.description: Following the discovery that Speaker L is a decoy and the imminent execution of Toad prisoners, Captain Fernback has assumed temporary command. The Council is in disarray.

speaker.title: Voice of the Pond
speaker.fullTitle: Voice of the Pond, Keeper of the Cohort, Emergency Commander

speaker.philosophy: Order through unity. Safety through vigilance. Justice through accountability.
speaker.description: Speaker L emerged as the spiritual and political leader during the chaos aboard the Vigilance. Their calm demeanor, unwavering moral compass, and almost supernatural ability to inspire loyalty rallied the traumatized toads into a cohesive force. While their methods can seem harsh, none doubt their commitment to the Cohort's survival.
quotes: This is not retribution's art, but the mending of the fractured heart.
By pond and law, by vow and steel, the wound must close for peace to heal.
We are not slaves to chaos. We are the Liberated.
Every toad who falls under my watch is a failure I carry forever.

Roger authorized lethal force against Legion spies
Roger invoked Speaker Audience to report on Rakasha contact

speakerRelationship.notes: With Speaker L revealed as a decoy/missing, the Liberators act independently. Captain Fernback respects them but is prioritizing military defense.

council.name: The Cohort Council
council.description: Seven elected representatives from each major cohort advise Speaker L. While the Speaker holds emergency powers, the Council provides crucial perspective and can override vetoes with a 2/3 majority.
council.meetingSchedule: Daily at dawn, emergency sessions as needed

members.name: Elder Mudcap

members.name: Captain Fernback

members.name: Forgemaster Ironspore

members.name: Warden Thornshell

activeVotes.title: CRISIS RESPONSE: ORDER 120
activeVotes.description: General Ironhand has issued 'Order 120': The immediate execution of all Toad prisoners at Aegis Command. Bones is confirmed among them, critically wounded. The 'Speaker L' in custody is confirmed to be a decoy.
activeVotes.background: We have less than an hour before executions begin. The infiltration team (Creek) is pinned down.

options.text: Suicide Assault - Throw everything at Aegis Command immediately
The hjumpik Bargain - Use the Oracle as leverage (hjumpik's connection)
Distraction Strike - Hit a different target to draw forces away
cons: Might not stop executions in time

activeVotes.speaker_statement: SPEAKER ABSENT. CAPTAIN FERNBACK ASSUMING TEMPORARY COMMAND.
activeVotes.notes: Situation critical. Bones life signs fading.

activeVotes.title: Response to the Iron Mandate
activeVotes.description: Suspended due to active combat scenario (Order 120).
activeVotes.background: Speaker Rivers resigned in protest. Legion patrols are mobilizing immediately. We have perhaps hours before they reach our position.

options.text: Full Evacuation - Abandon the Vigilance and scatter to pre-arranged safe houses
Diplomatic Outreach - Contact moderate Diet members and attempt negotiation
Armed Resistance - Fortify current position and prepare for siege
Strategic Withdrawal - Relocate Vigilance to allied territory (Rakasha lands)

activeVotes.title: Fate of the Iron Legion Prisoners
activeVotes.description: We hold 6 Iron Legion soldiers captured during various engagements. With the Iron Mandate now in effect, their status becomes more complicated.

options.text: Execute as enemy combatants under wartime protocols
Prisoner exchange - Trade for Bones and any other captured toads
Release with a message - Let them go with terms for future engagement

activeVotes.speaker_statement: Bones was taken under my watch. I want him back. If we can trade soldiers for our people, we should.
activeVotes.notes: Forgemaster Ironspore has abstained, citing conflict of interest - his brother was killed by the Legion.

recentVotes.title: The Scavenging Doctrine
recentVotes.result: Option B (Dan's Proposal) - Large cautious expeditions
recentVotes.summary: Established protocol for larger, more cautious resource gathering expeditions over Archie's proposed small high-risk teams. This marked a significant return to influence for Dan and a shift toward safety.
recentVotes.long_term_effects: Resource gathering slowed but casualties reduced

recentVotes.title: Emergency Resolution 17-A
recentVotes.result: Enacted - Speaker L granted emergency powers
recentVotes.summary: Granted Speaker L emergency powers following the Raventree Manor crisis. Established the Accountability Docket. Created the current governance structure.
recentVotes.long_term_effects: Centralized authority, increased order, some liberty concerns

recentVotes.title: Containment of Raventree Manor
recentVotes.summary: Authorized the Pond Patrol to establish a containment perimeter around Raventree Manor to prevent supernatural threats from spreading.
recentVotes.dissent: Healer Mistpetal voted against, concerned about cutting off trapped individuals

recentVotes.title: Medical Priority Protocol
recentVotes.summary: Established formal triage protocols for the overwhelmed Menders cohort. Core party members do not receive priority over other toads.
recentVotes.long_term_effects: Fair but slower treatment for high-profile patients

events.title: Iron Mandate Enacted
events.description: The Midlands Diet passes the Iron Mandate. The Liberated Toads are classified as an 'organized supernatural entity.'

events.title: Dragon Conspiracy Revealed
events.description: Robinson (Markop's father) discovers the Dragon-Empire war is a fabrication. He and the dragon 'Ignis-Major' are captured by the Legion.

events.title: Massacre at Aegis Command
events.description: Infiltration failed. Bones stabbed by General Ironhand. A 'Green Decoy' of Speaker L was discovered. Ironhand issues 'Order 120': Execute all Toad prisoners.

events.title: Banishment of the Wraith
events.description: The party defeats an Arcane Wraith at Raventree Manor. Dan fights one-armed; Bowser physically assaults the ghost. The Oracle banishes the entity.

events.title: Iron Mandate Enacted
events.description: The Midlands Diet passes the Iron Mandate 28-8-3, granting the Iron Legion emergency powers to purge supernatural threats. The Liberated Toads are now classified as an 'organized supernatural entity.'

events.title: Emergency Vote Called
events.description: Speaker L convenes the Council to vote on the faction's response. Four options presented: evacuation, diplomacy, resistance, or strategic withdrawal.

events.title: Council Deliberation
events.description: The Council debates. Strategic Withdrawal currently leads with 3 votes. Legion patrols are mobilizing.

events.title: Vigilance Captured
events.description: The Iron Legion boards and captures the Vigilance.

events.title: Vigilance Captured
events.description: The Iron Legion boards and captures the Vigilance. Multiple toads forced to escape, including Ryan who jumps from the ship.

events.title: Bones Confirmed Captured
events.description: Bones is confirmed held at an Imperial Processing Facility. Council begins planning rescue operation.

events.title: Ryan Meets Rakasha
events.description: Ryan survives their fall and is taken in by a Rakasha spirit-walker who senses their magical potential.

events.title: Spider Grove Rescue
events.description: Markop and Remi rescue Eager from a web-choked grove in Raventree Manor, defeating a massive Arachnid Matriarch.

events.title: Containment Perimeter
events.description: Pond Patrol establishes containment perimeter around Raventree Manor. The manor responds by manifesting powerful wraiths.

events.title: Green T Lost
events.description: Green T is violently pulled into a mirror dimension by a supernatural entity. Status: Unknown, presumed lost.

events.title: Archie Surrenders
events.description: Archie surrenders to Speaker L to buy time, but a glass monster emerges from a mirror, complicating the situation.

events.title: Emergency Powers Granted
events.description: Council unanimously passes Emergency Resolution 17-A, granting Speaker L emergency powers. The Accountability Docket is established.

events.title: Supernatural Sovereignty Act
events.description: The Regal Empire passes a law declaring organized vampires and werewolves illegal, effectively declaring war on supernatural factions.

events.title: Raventree Standoff
events.description: Speaker L's Pond Patrol besieges Archie and hjumpik in the manor after a failed healing attempt on Eager.

events.title: Scavenging Doctrine Vote
events.description: Dan's proposal for cautious expeditions defeats Archie's high-risk plan 5-1. First major policy shift toward safety.

events.title: The Dinner That Broke Time
events.description: Toads enter Shadeward Mansion seeking Archie. Encounter the Oracle, time loops, multiple Archie clones, and an Iron Legion raid.

events.title: The Mole Revealed
events.description: The Mole's true allegiance to the Iron Legion is exposed. Bones is captured during the chaos. Trust in the Scout cohort shattered.

events.title: FNG Remi Arrives
events.description: Remi is discovered in a crate. Wario gives her an exploding box. She survives and is offered a place in his crew.

events.title: Cone of Cold Incident
events.description: Waluigi's Cone of Cold spell freezes Eager solid and injures Remi. Eager presumed dead by the crew.

events.title: 150 Toads Discovered
events.description: The Iron Legion reveals that 150+ trafficked toads are hidden in barrels throughout the ship, accessible via Mini-Mushroom.

events.title: X.O. Neutralized
events.description: The party, with critical assistance from Dan the Toad, neutralizes X.O. and regains control of the Vigilance.

coreToads.name: Dan
coreToads.title: The Faithful
coreToads.background: Dan has rallied from his catatonic state. Fighting with a longsword in his remaining hand, he proved he is still a warrior of the Pond. He is currently separated from Toad Lee and Ryan. Dan successfully avoided conflict by dancing with the satyrs.

personality.ideal: Faith in the Pond guides all
personality.bond: Will protect any toad with my life

coreToads.name: Eager
coreToads.title: The Swift
coreToads.background: Currently comatose after the battle with the Arachnid Matriarch. Eager was captured while running from the scene.

complicated: Waluigi - nearly killed by his Cone of Cold

coreToads.name: Ryan
coreToads.title: The Arcane
coreToads.background: Ryan has been taken in by the Rakasha spirit-walker. While his mentor deals with threats like Thorne and guides Hjumpik, Ryan is safe within their sanctum, observing the chaotic magic of the fracture.

personality.bond: My spellbook is my most treasured possession
My weapons are extensions of myself

coreToads.name: Bones
coreToads.title: The Unbreakable
coreToads.status: Active - Cleaned up from being grotesque mushroom
coreToads.background: Awaiting execution at Aegis Command. Bones was recognized by Byscilla Danos and dragged away.

personality.bond: I will break anyone who hurts my friends
personality.flaw: Sometimes can't stop once I start

coreToads.name: Toad Lee
coreToads.title: The Relentless
coreToads.background: Toad Lee has once again survived the impossible. Finding refuge in a Hag's house, he found Waluigi caged and injured. Showing quick thinking, he tricked the Hag (Stucky) into revealing how to disarm her own bear trap, then broke Waluigi out. He is currently fleeing through a sprite-infested greenhouse. Toad Lee managed to sneak past the satyrs and attempted to take some spoils from the fallen goblin. Toad Lee broke through a wall with Hjumpik and grabbed some gold. Kidnapped. None mentioned.

personality.bond: The Barrel Survivors are my family now

coreToads.name: Waluigi
coreToads.title: The Lanky Sorcerer
coreToads.background: A chaotic variable in the equation. Waluigi previously froze Eager, but found himself captured by Stucky the Hag in the Planar Fracture. His leg was brutally injured (bone exposed). Toad Lee saved him from being eaten. Waluigi was injured while triggering an explosion.

personality.ideal: Everyone cheats, I just do it better

coreToads.affiliationLabel: Not a Liberated Toad — outside party, docket subject
coreToads.affiliationNote: Waluigi is NOT a member of the Liberated Toads and NOT part of the Pond Patrol. He appears in this record only because he is a subject of the Accountability Docket and was present for the Raventree events. His abilities belong to his own sheet, not the Toad roster.

coreToads.name: The Mole
coreToads.title: The Traitor

personality.bond: Iron Legion is my true family

coreToads.affiliationNote: Former Scout cohort leader. Betrayed the Cohort on Day 16; the seventh Council seat is still empty because of him.

pondPatrolNote: The Pond Patrol is a 24-member cohort commanded by Captain Fernback. None of the named core roster below serve in it; Waluigi in particular is an outsider and a docket subject, not an officer.
